column3: (Modern Web Application: informational; the portal is an SPA)
(Storable and Cacheable Content: by design; hashed /assets/* are public immutable and HTML is no-cache)
(Re-examine Cache-control Directives: by design; the SPA shell is no-cache so it revalidates and holds nothing user-specific)
(Proxy Disclosure: the edge is a reverse proxy by design; TRACE, OPTIONS and TRACK get a bare 405 with no Server or Via for every Max-Forwards, so ZAP finds a proxy but no product or version)
